Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District issued solicitation JA-207652 / SOURCING #168884 titled "Student and Staff Computing Devices" with a 3‑year term (plus two 1‑year extensions) and a due date of July 9 2024 2:00 PM CST (updated by Addendum 2). A pre‑bid meeting is scheduled for June 10 2024 2:00 PM CST (03:00 PM EDT) via TEAMS, and quotes are requested to begin in September 2024 per Addendum 1. Submissions may be made online via the iSupplier portal or by manual sealed envelope, must include Forms 1295, W‑9, SS‑4, and W‑7, and require manufacturer or authorized reseller qualifications with factory‑authorized repair certifications; the procurement is a cooperative agreement through the Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (no piggyback). The award will cover 50,000 Tier 1 Small Student Chromebooks (Touch), 50,000 Tier 2 Large Student Chromebooks (Non‑Touch) with specs detailed in Addendum 1, 1 Tier 1 Staff Basic Desktop, and 1 Student Tablet, with imaging, deployment coordination, and white‑glove services (asset decaling, etching) also updated by Addendum 1.
